records.quote: Here, we modulate interlayer bonding heterogeneity via a charge-balanced one Cr replaces three Cu strategy to form (Cu1-3 xCrx)CrTi2Se6, achieving electron-phonon decoupling.
context_quotes: Structural characterizations and density functional theory calculations confirm Cr incorporation into interlayer octahedral sites, inducing two synergistic effects: (i) Replacing ionic interlayer Cu & horbar;Se bonds with more covalent Cr & horbar;Se bonds facilitates rapid interlayer charge transfer and enhances carrier mobility by similar to 60% without altering the electronic band structure; (ii) The reduced interlayer atomic density induced by non-equiatomic Cr/Cu substitution weakens interlayer mechanical coupling, as evidenced by a suppressed shear modulus and transverse sound velocity.

records.subject: Fine-grained sandstones with small pore throat diameter
records.object: Pore throat radius greater than approximately 4000 times diffuse layer thickness
records.quote: Diffusion potentials dominate only if the pore throat radius is more than approximately 4000 times larger than the diffuse layer thickness.

records.subject: Temperature gradients
records.conditions: Subsurface settings discussed in self-potential surveys
records.quote: Exclusion-diffusion potentials arising from temperature gradients are widely neglected in self-potential (SP) surveys, despite the ubiquitous presence of temperature gradients in subsurface settings such as volcanoes and hot springs, geothermal fields, and oil reservoirs during production via water or steam injection.

records.subject: Concentration gradients
records.conditions: In the context of self-potential surveys
records.quote: Likewise, with the exception of borehole SP logging, exclusion-diffusion potentials arising from concentration gradients are also neglected or, at best, it is assumed that the diffusion potential dominates.
